findings.detail: The vehicle gate permits generation to remain UNVERIFIED while allowing specifications whose scope uses the intake placeholder BEV_REFERENCE. That placeholder identifies a powertrain reference, not a verified generation. This can admit parameters without the generation binding required by VEHICLE_FACT_BINDING. The independent review checks exact scope against the same intake placeholder, so it does not close the gap.
findings.required_fix: Require evidence of the actual generation before allowing generation-bound vehicle parameters. If it remains unverified, block the affected specifications and permit conditional writing only if the buyer task can be answered without them. Add a regression test proving that a BEV_REFERENCE placeholder cannot authorize those specifications.
